<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>ECI symbol freeze:</strong> The Election Commission’s decision to freeze the TMC name and symbol for bypolls has sparked a political row, with Congress accusing the ECI of acting as a &quot;BJP puppet&quot; while the BJP claims the party faces imminent decline.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary oversight:</strong> Congress leader Gaurav Gogoi has challenged the government over a proposed &#x27;UPI tax,&#x27; alleging that the move bypassed necessary scrutiny by the Parliamentary Finance Committee.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial interventions:</strong> The Supreme Court has questioned Tamil Nadu’s stance on Hindi language opposition and is hearing a plea regarding the transparency of criteria used by the ECI to issue notices to voters for &quot;logical discrepancies.&quot;<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxONnpockZrQzVHbVRUSzhmUm1jRlVOc2ZwSTVMRTZIOHFBLTgxeEE5blZOYWI2SG5JVGxqeDg3RUhrSUd1dXpjRk5uSVFXSmJSN2ROcU9tSzNPVENjRUpOMnlyVTBxYUtYNC0wSm9EN3BISEFJOFcxejlkZENncVRybWZLekJnRWFfb0VfMEFpT1gzclNaTmQ3MVNLNHJxZl9XSG1QblBBRnQwazNIYlh1R1Bn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Foreign policy criticism:</strong> The Congress party has criticized the Union government&#x27;s foreign policy approach following the passage of new US sanctions against Russia, labeling the government&#x27;s strategy as ineffective.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxNSXNDOEN1MV9SU2R3VlFoa0dEWXJSNUFQNFNSUlNKQWh2YWYxTjlac3MxSGdZV2pMbUNPVWl5cFZUUVFLVkpENV9tcW1jbzUySW93aEZFd0ZfdVo4WWR4MHpJWlp2TVpzNlZWc2FqcXVteFVFYWVkbHJRVm1RNG5MRkV2azBWZlEyQ1FORjZaWTZhbEFITVVEbEI2dlR4WHFWeXVRRjZfZUlxbW1ieFh1WWViS004VV9NLUl0bkV4NA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Education and language policy:</strong> The Supreme Court has reprimanded the CBSE for its refusal to grant an exemption to Class VI students from the mandatory three-language policy for the current academic year.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
